Zero Blocking findings. Four Non-Blocking findings independently reproduced and disclosed: dead InvariantContext live-comparison fields; the one real production call site never wires AdapterSources (11/15 adapters unverifiable, never falsely conformant) and transition_id==phase_id causes a same-phase content correction to be safely discarded as publish_failed; a pre-existing PFR/task-lifecycle reconciliation conflict outside src/pcae/cltr (135K's report re-promoted under the same phase_id by a later closure task), documented not repaired; placeholder repository_identity/branch_identity in production wiring. Added 5 new independent regression tests; no repair to src/pcae/cltr required. All four of 135J's inherited Non-Blocking findings independently re-verified unchanged. Verdict: VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS. No authority cutover, no execution capability introduced. Next: 135M - Production CLTR Dual-Derivation and Atomic Publication Contract / Migration Plan.
